name: M3_OIS100MI_UpdCOPlanDates
description: Update planning, requested delivery, departure, and confirmed delivery dates on existing customer orders by creating a background update in *Batch Customer Order. Open* (OIS275). The logic is the same as changing dates interactively in *Customer Order. Open Line* (OIS101): available-to-promise (ATP) is checked, and potential shortages are handled in the same way. Dates can be adjusted for the whole order or for a single line, in either the customer's or the warehouse's time zone. The operation does not recalculate sales prices; use the price update operation instead.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number whose planning and delivery dates are to be updated.

inputParameters.name: PONR
inputParameters.description: Order line number to update; leave blank to update all lines on the order.

inputParameters.name: POSX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying a specific subline of the order line to update.

inputParameters.name: DWDT
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery date in the delivering warehouse time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: DWHM
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery time in the delivering warehouse time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: DWDZ
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery date at the customer's final destination in the customer's time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: DWHZ
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery time at the customer's final destination in the customer's time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date for the lines, overriding the normal supply planning date when entered.

inputParameters.name: PLHM
inputParameters.description: Planning time of day for the lines, used together with the planning date.

inputParameters.name: DSDT
inputParameters.description: Planned departure date for the delivery of the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: DSHM
inputParameters.description: Planned departure time for the delivery of the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: CODT
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date in the delivering warehouse time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: COHM
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery time in the delivering warehouse time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: CODZ
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date at the customer's final destination in the customer's time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: COHZ
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery time at the customer's final destination in the customer's time zone to set for the selected lines.

inputParameters.name: RSC7
inputParameters.description: Time-related reason code explaining why the planning or delivery time is changed.

inputParameters.name: OATP
inputParameters.description: Indicator to bypass available-to-promise checks for the affected lines; must be set to 1 when a planning date is entered.

inputParameters.name: UATP
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether an ATP date suggested due to shortage is automatically accepted and used as the new date (1) or not (0).

inputParameters.name: MODE
inputParameters.description: Update execution mode, where 'A' runs via autojob OIS960 and is recommended; blank or 'S' runs a submitted job, but GetUpdateSts can be used to check completion when 'S' is selected.

outputParameters.name: TSTM
outputParameters.description: Timestamp key for the submitted update job to be used as input to GetUpdateSts when checking its status.
